_comment: ngsolve hdivdiv#4 (Regge vs HHJ; porting a 2D HHJ plate to 3D). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_cube maxh=0.5 (nv=26 ne=53 nedge=96 nface=124). The ported 2D form (specialcf.normal(2), Id(2)) does not assemble on a 3D mesh: NgException "Dimensions don't match, op = -". HDivDiv(3D, order=1) has relative nn facet jump 6.8e-17 but relative FULL TRACTION (sigma.n) jump 1.57 -- nn-conforming, NOT traction-conforming, so the catalog's 'prescribed traction continuity' is wrong while its 'traction jumps at facets' is right. HCurlCurl(3D) (Regge) is the complementary space: relative tt jump 1.9e-17, relative nn jump 1.40, and HCurlCurl(order=0).ndof == mesh.nedge == 96 exactly (one dof per edge, the defining property of lowest-order Regge). MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 sets PORTED_FORM_DIM=3, so specialcf.normal(3) and Id(3) are used and the ported plate form is dimensionally consistent with the 3D mesh -- the documented fix applied at the pathology site. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 9 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 assembles the form without raising, so it removes 'ported_2d_form_on_3d_raises=True' and the literal expectation 'Dimensions don't match' and makes the forbidden 'FAIL:' appear. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
